episode_title: From 80 Hours to 40: How Jayde Whelan Got Her Life Back

real_qa.q: How did Jade Whelan reduce her working hours from 80 to 40 hours per week at JD Painting Co in 12 months?
real_qa.r: Jade implemented job management software, transitioned from sole trader to company structure, hired her sister Ebony for operations and back-office support, added painters and another van, promoted a leading hand, created systems and checklists through 'the JD Painting Way', implemented a CRM, and set up a separate business phone line so clients would contact Ebony first instead of calling her directly. She shifted her focus from working in the business to working on the business through better delegation and systems.
real_qa.requete: Jade Whelan JD Painting Co 80 to 40 hours

real_qa.q: What awards did JD Painting Co win under Jade Whelan's leadership in the last 12 months?
real_qa.r: JD Painting Co won the Australian Trade Small Business Award for Painting, as well as Master Painters Awards for Excellence in both the decorative finishes and heritage restoration categories, both in the domestic under 100k category, with the team present to share in the recognition.
real_qa.requete: JD Painting Co awards Australian Trade Master Painters

guest.bio_context: Jade Whelan is the owner of JD Painting Co, based in regional Victoria in the Macedon Ranges. She comes from a diverse professional background including sound engineering, sales, retail, and business development, and holds a business degree in music industry. She initially worked as a labourer and brush hand in her father's painting business before starting her own as a sole trader and growing it organically through word of mouth over several years.

real_quote: Every business owner, I think, runs a business because they want freedom. And then you build yourself a prison.
